headline.title: The Holiday Train Show is now running
headline.body: NYBG's conservatory opened yesterday with model trains winding past miniature NYC landmarks built from plant parts. A good cold-weather Sunday trip.
headline.meta: New York Botanical Garden, the Bronx · timed tickets

picks.title: Armand Hammer at Music Hall of Williamsburg
picks.body: The Brooklyn rap duo plays a Sunday night at the Williamsburg room. Check the venue for doors and tickets.

picks.title: Film Forum starts a Rossellini retrospective
picks.body: A 26-film run opens Monday with Rome Open City, Paisan, Stromboli and more, in 35mm prints and new 4K restorations.

picks.title: Lightscape opens at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
picks.body: The garden's winter light trail returns with a new route. Timed tickets are required and popular dates can sell out.

picks.title: The Photography Triennial: After Dark opens
picks.body: The Museum of the City of New York looks at the city's nightlife through contemporary photography, opening to the public Friday.
picks.meta: Museum of the City of New York · admission
picks.place: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem

picks.title: Guster at Music Hall of Williamsburg
picks.body: The band is listed for back-to-back nights at the Williamsburg venue. Confirm which night has tickets left.

picks.title: Historic New York: a Greenpoint history walk
picks.body: NYC Parks rangers lead a walk on the neighborhood's industrial past and immigrant communities, ending at WNYC Transmitter Park.

picks.title: Greenpoint-McCarren Park Greenmarket
picks.body: The Saturday farmers market sets up on Union Avenue between Driggs and N 12th Street.

picks.title: Brooklyn Flea at the Dumbo Archway
picks.body: The weekend flea is listed for Nov 14-15, 21-22 and 28-29 under the Manhattan Bridge arches. Vintage, makers and gifts.

facts.t: This year's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is the 100th, even though it began in 1924. The parade paused for three years during World War II.

countdowns.title: Lightscape opens
countdowns.body: Brooklyn Botanic Garden's winter light trail runs Nov 20 to Jan 3.

countdowns.title: 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
countdowns.body: Thursday, 8:30 AM to noon, from 77th Street to Herald Square. Free on the sidewalk.

countdowns.title: Rockefeller Center tree lighting
countdowns.body: The 2026 ceremony is Wednesday, Dec 2. Free, first come, first served.
